skipInvalidRows.description: Apply the valid rows and leave the invalid ones behind. Without it, a session that still holds invalid rows is refused (409 IMPORT_HAS_INVALID_ROWS) — importing a partial file has to be a deliberate choice.

billingCycleAnchor.description: CALENDAR: one shared calendar month, mid-month joiners prorated. ENROLLMENT: each student rolls on their own join-date anniversary (join Jul 12 → billed Jul 12–Aug 11, then Aug 12–Sep 11), every cycle whole and at full price. PREPAID only; billingDay/dueDay are unread and dueOffsetDays sets the due date. ENROLLMENT is the platform default; a tenant opts into CALENDAR.

billingDay.description: CALENDAR anchoring only — the day periodic generation starts

dueDay.description: CALENDAR anchoring only — the day of the month invoices fall due

dueOffsetDays.description: ENROLLMENT anchoring only — days after a cycle starts that its invoice falls due (0 = the cycle’s first day)

immediateDueDays.description: Due offset for immediately-issued invoices (0 = same day)

lateFeeAmount.description: Fixed amount, or percentage (0–100) when lateFeeType=PERCENT

lateFeeMaxTotal.description: Cap on total late fees per invoice; null = uncapped

autoSuspendAfterDays.description: Auto-suspend N days past due; null = disabled

autoCancelAfterDays.description: Auto-cancel N days past due; null = disabled (must exceed suspend)

permissionCodes.description: Full replacement set of permission codes for the role. Empty array clears all permissions.

firstName.description: Required only when phone is a new user

lastName.description: Required only when phone is a new user

amount.description: Signed, non-zero. Negative debits the wallet (never below zero).

reason.example: Goodwill correction for a scheduling error

payrollType.description: How auto-calculated payroll derives the gross: FIXED (baseSalary / hourly) or PERCENT (share of group fee-plan revenue).

payrollPercent.description: Revenue-share percentage. Required when payrollType is PERCENT.

roleName.description: Default: TEACHER. Also ADMIN or MANAGER.

Re-validated against the course branch; changing either side re-checks both.

regenerateSessions.description: Regenerate future SCHEDULED sessions from the updated schedule rule. Required (true or false) whenever scheduleRule actually changes — otherwise the request is rejected with REGENERATE_SESSIONS_REQUIRED.

studentIds.description: Array of student IDs for batch enrollment

enrolledAt.description: The date the student actually joined (YYYY-MM-DD). This is the billing anniversary anchor, so set it when a student is added to the group later than they really started — otherwise they are billed from the day the record was created. Defaults to today in the center’s timezone. Must fall within the current billing period and no more than one month ahead; anything earlier would skip billing cycles that no job will ever issue.

status.description: Transition the enrollment: SUSPENDED (hold), ACTIVE (reactivate a suspended one), DROPPED (requires dropReason), COMPLETED, TRANSFERRED (create the new enrollment separately). Must be a valid transition from the current status.

type.description: Line classification; defaults to TUITION. Only TUITION/OTHER are client-settable — LATE_FEE/ADJUSTMENT/PACKAGE are system-generated only.
